title: Think Like a Scientist: Analysis, Synthesis and Discussion
objective: Students combine information from more than one source and write cautious academic conclusions.
outcomes: Use cautious language such as may, might, suggest.
activity: Synthesis matrix: students compare two short article summaries using method, result, limitation, and useful quote.
example: One plant-growth paper may show a strong light effect; another may show only a small effect because the observation period was shorter.

classroom.title: Connect two studies of light and plant growth
classroom.description: Compare growth patterns in lettuce and spinach using the evidence from both studies.
